red-herring-stall-neighbor.desc: a shopkeeper from the next block

s3-suspect.desc: a young man in a red cap

s4-thief.desc: a man in a gray hood

extra:patron2.desc: a customer in a silver coat

extra:stallkeeper2.desc: a stall keeper in an apron

extra:bucket.desc: a stall keeper with a bucket

tokens-at-the-door.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} stands at the corner, lips moving as {veteran-officer.he} counts the Dome queue.

tokens-at-the-door.1.2.line: {extra:patron} steps out of the queue and hands {boss-careful} a snack token.

tokens-at-the-door.1.3.line: {boss-careful} waves {extra:patron} in past forty people still waiting.

tokens-at-the-door.2.1.line: {red-herring-stall-neighbor} argues with {boss-careful} and points at the blocked loading bay.

tokens-at-the-door.3.1.line: {boss-careful} takes a snack token from {extra:patron2} and waves {extra:patron2} straight in.

patrol-drifts-past-the-dome.1.1.line: {inside-officer} and {framed-officer} pass the Neon Dome on a new patrol loop.

patrol-drifts-past-the-dome.1.2.line: {framed-officer} scans the Dome door while {inside-officer} keeps walking and nods at the door staff.

patrol-drifts-past-the-dome.1.3.line: {framed-officer} writes in a paper notebook and keeps it in {framed-officer.his} pocket.

patrol-drifts-past-the-dome.2.1.line: At the corner, {framed-officer} says to {inside-officer}: "We turned left here yesterday."

patrol-drifts-past-the-dome.2.2.line: {inside-officer} shrugs and takes the new route anyway, {framed-officer} a step behind.

snack-stand-regular.1.1.line: {informant} serves two cups across the snack stand counter.

snack-stand-regular.1.2.line: {informant} looks over at the Dome door staff, then down at the counter top.

snack-stand-regular.2.1.line: {veteran-officer} sits down at the snack stand counter in the afternoon lull.

snack-stand-regular.2.2.line: {veteran-officer} and {informant} eat on the same bench without a word.

snack-stand-regular.2.3.line: {informant} gets up and leaves the bench first.

odd-hours-at-the-dome.1.1.line: {red-herring-night-courier} stands in the Dome queue in the middle of the night.

odd-hours-at-the-dome.1.2.line: {red-herring-night-courier} steps out of the queue and knocks at the Dome staff door.

odd-hours-at-the-dome.1.3.line: {family-caller-officer} walks past the Dome queue on the night round.

odd-hours-at-the-dome.1.4.line: Comm, one side, {family-caller-officer}: "Not now, Mama. Saturday, I promise."

odd-hours-at-the-dome.1.5.line: {go-between-bartender} serves {extra:regular} first while twelve people wait at the bar kiosk.

odd-hours-at-the-dome.1.6.line: {go-between-bartender} slides {extra:regular} a paper tab across the kiosk.

odd-hours-at-the-dome.2.1.line: {go-between-courier} bumps into {go-between-bartender} at the bar kiosk back door.

odd-hours-at-the-dome.2.3.line: {go-between-courier} leaves by the Dome service door with the paper bag.

odd-hours-at-the-dome.2.4.line: {rookie-officer} calls out, and {red-herring-night-courier} runs from the Dome queue.

odd-hours-at-the-dome.2.5.line: {rookie-officer} chases {red-herring-night-courier} and loses {red-herring-night-courier.him} at the lift.

scan-log-and-badge.1.1.line: {framed-officer} reads a scan log on the front screen twice: "Neon Dome door, 23:41," under {framed-officer.his} badge.

scan-log-and-badge.1.2.line: {framed-officer} points at the line with {framed-officer.his} own badge number on it.

scan-log-and-badge.1.3.line: {framed-officer} argues with {desk-sergeant} and holds up the desk sign-in sheet: "23:30 to 00:10."

scan-log-and-badge.2.1.line: {inside-officer} stands at the back of the morning briefing.

scan-log-and-badge.2.2.line: {inside-officer} takes {framed-officer}'s badge out of the locker while {framed-officer} sits in the briefing.

scan-log-and-badge.2.3.line: {inside-officer} puts {framed-officer}'s badge back in the locker and shuts the door.

coat-bags-in-the-plaza.1.1.line: {go-between-courier} carries a bag into the market plaza, a Dome tag stub on the handle.

coat-bags-in-the-plaza.1.2.line: {go-between-courier} hands the bag to {extra:stallkeeper} and gets a thin pouch back.

coat-bags-in-the-plaza.2.1.line: {go-between-courier} carries a second bag with a Dome tag stub into the plaza.

coat-bags-in-the-plaza.2.2.line: {go-between-courier} waits at the counter of {extra:stallkeeper2}, holding the bag out.

coat-bags-in-the-plaza.2.3.line: {extra:stallkeeper2} pushes the bag back at {go-between-courier} and points at the exit.

coat-bags-in-the-plaza.2.4.line: {go-between-courier} walks out of the plaza with the bag still in hand.

envelope-lifted.1.1.line: {go-between-courier} stands at the sky mall rail holding a brown envelope.

envelope-lifted.1.2.line: {s4-thief} walks straight into {go-between-courier} at the rail and keeps going.

envelope-lifted.1.3.line: {go-between-courier} pats {go-between-courier.his} empty pockets and runs after {s4-thief}.

envelope-lifted.1.4.line: {rookie-officer} asks {go-between-courier} what was in the envelope.

tower-unit.1.1.line: {go-between-courier} rides the tower lift up to floor 31 with a takeaway bag.

tower-unit.1.2.line: {go-between-courier} knocks at door 31C and waits with the takeaway bag.

tower-unit.1.3.line: {go-between-courier} goes into 31C, and the door shuts behind {go-between-courier.him}.

tower-unit.2.1.line: {boss-careful} crosses the tower lobby in a Neon Dome staff jacket.

tower-unit.2.2.line: {boss-careful} steps into the tower lift, still in the Dome jacket.

stall-fire-cousin-held.1.1.line: Smoke rolls over the stall row in the market plaza.

stall-fire-cousin-held.1.2.line: {extra:bucket} runs toward the burning stall with a bucket of water.

stall-fire-cousin-held.2.1.line: {burnout-officer} sits on a plaza seat and stays there for forty minutes.

stall-fire-cousin-held.2.2.line: {burnout-officer} eats alone on the seat, long after the lunch crowd has gone.

stall-fire-cousin-held.2.3.line: {burnout-officer} opens {s3-suspect}'s bag: Dome coat tag stubs and a snack token.

stand-empty-staff-door-opens.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} waits outside the snack stand at the usual hour.

stand-empty-staff-door-opens.1.2.line: {extra:stranger} serves at the snack stand counter alone.

stand-empty-staff-door-opens.1.3.line: {veteran-officer} points at the shutter pulled down over one side of the snack stand.

stand-empty-staff-door-opens.1.4.line: At the Dome staff door, {extra:cleaner} opens up and hugs {red-herring-night-courier}.

stand-empty-staff-door-opens.1.5.line: {red-herring-night-courier} hands {extra:cleaner} a bag of flowers and bread.

evidence-cage-and-station-2.1.1.line: {inside-officer} carries a box out of the evidence cage.

evidence-cage-and-station-2.1.2.line: {inside-officer} signs the cage sheet with a short code and leaves.

evidence-cage-and-station-2.2.1.line: {inside-officer-extra} sits apart from the others at the morning briefing.

evidence-cage-and-station-2.2.2.line: {inside-officer-extra} is the first one out of the briefing.

evidence-cage-and-station-2.2.3.line: {inside-officer-extra} asks {desk-sergeant} what station 1 is working on.

evidence-cage-and-station-2.2.5.line: {family-caller-officer} shows {desk-sergeant} a kid's drawing, pointing at each figure.

evidence-cage-and-station-2.3.1.line: {desk-sergeant} reads the cage sheet: four items logged, three on the shelf.

thief-arrested.1.1.line: {go-between-courier} waits at the sky mall rail, watching the crowd.

thief-arrested.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} arrests {s4-thief} near the sky mall rail.

thief-arrested.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} opens the brown envelope taken off {s4-thief}.

thief-arrested.1.4.line: {rookie-officer} reads the stubs: snack tokens stamped with queue numbers, and bar tabs.

unit-searched.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} knock at door 31C and wait.

unit-searched.1.3.line: {veteran-officer} finds coat bags and a pile of snack tokens in the unit.

unit-searched.1.5.line: {inside-officer} arrives in the corridor and offers to walk {go-between-courier} down to the station.

unit-searched.1.6.line: {go-between-courier} steps back from {inside-officer} and shakes {go-between-courier.his} head.

service-door-to-the-foundry.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} watches the Dome service door from across the lane.

service-door-to-the-foundry.1.2.line: {go-between-bartender} leaves by the Dome service door and walks to the foundry.

service-door-to-the-foundry.1.3.line: {go-between-bartender} goes in through the foundry office door.

service-door-to-the-foundry.2.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} sits outside the foundry with a flask in {night-stakeout-officer.his} lap.

service-door-to-the-foundry.2.2.line: {night-stakeout-officer} keeps watching the foundry office door.

service-door-to-the-foundry.2.3.line: {boss-careful}, in a Dome staff jacket, goes into the foundry office.

service-door-to-the-foundry.2.4.line: {night-stakeout-officer} leaves, a paper cup left behind on the ledge.

poster-and-empty-cage.1.1.line: {red-herring-stall-neighbor} stands outside the station screens for ten minutes.

poster-and-empty-cage.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} reads the landlord receipt: "Back rent received, paid in full."

poster-and-empty-cage.1.4.line: {red-herring-stall-neighbor} opens {red-herring-stall-neighbor.his} heavy bag: loaves of bread stock.

poster-and-empty-cage.1.5.line: {desk-sergeant} posts a wanted poster to the screens, and the face match shows {framed-officer}'s badge photo.

poster-and-empty-cage.1.6.line: {framed-officer} argues with {desk-sergeant} in front of the poster over the face match.

poster-and-empty-cage.2.1.line: {desk-sergeant} opens the evidence cage and finds the shelf empty.

poster-and-empty-cage.2.2.line: The sign-out tag on the empty shelf carries {framed-officer}'s badge number.

poster-and-empty-cage.2.3.line: The screen shows a notice: "{framed-officer}, suspended pending review."

poster-and-empty-cage.2.4.line: {framed-officer} sits alone at the food counter.

roster-at-briefing.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} points at the roster screen and reads out the foundry stakeout.

roster-at-briefing.1.3.line: {inside-officer} and {desk-sergeant} swap roster slips across the desk.

roster-at-briefing.1.4.line: {burnout-officer} slips into the back row late and shrugs at {desk-sergeant}.

roster-at-briefing.1.5.line: {night-stakeout-officer} leaves the station for the Dome service door.

roster-at-briefing.1.6.line: Outside the station, comm, one side, {inside-officer}: "Not here."

roster-at-briefing.1.7.line: {night-stakeout-officer} watches the Dome service door while the foundry door stays dark.

statement-and-tab-book.1.1.line: {informant} comes back and sits down beside {veteran-officer}.

statement-and-tab-book.1.2.line: {informant} tells {veteran-officer} {informant.he} watched snack tokens change hands at the Dome door.

statement-and-tab-book.1.3.line: {informant} points across the square at the Dome door staff.

statement-and-tab-book.1.5.line: {rookie-officer} and {veteran-officer} arrest {go-between-bartender} at the bar kiosk.

statement-and-tab-book.1.6.line: {rookie-officer} pulls a tab book out from under the kiosk till.

statement-and-tab-book.1.7.line: {rookie-officer} reads the tab book: its numbers run the same as the stamped token numbers.

log-does-not-fit.1.1.line: {rookie-officer} lays the scan log beside {framed-officer}'s desk sign-in sheet.

log-does-not-fit.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} points at one line of the scan log: "23:41."

log-does-not-fit.1.3.line: {veteran-officer} says to {rookie-officer}: "Ask who held the handheld."

log-does-not-fit.1.4.line: Through the door, comm, one side, {inside-officer}: "Not here."

log-does-not-fit.1.5.line: {night-stakeout-officer} lays down the comm log showing the time of {inside-officer}'s call.

log-does-not-fit.2.1.line: {desk-sergeant} posts a correction to the screens that removes {framed-officer}'s name.

log-does-not-fit.2.2.line: {framed-officer} hands {desk-sergeant} {framed-officer.his} paper notebook across the desk.

a-at-the-front-screens.1.1.line: {inside-officer} stands at the front screens before the morning briefing.

a-at-the-front-screens.1.3.line: {framed-officer} arrests {inside-officer} in front of the screens.

a-at-the-front-screens.1.5.line: {desk-sergeant} watches from the desk and says nothing.

foundry-office.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} open the foundry office and search it.

foundry-office.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} points at coat bags and an evidence tag from the station cage.

foundry-office.2.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer}, {veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} wait by the foundry office door before dawn.

foundry-office.2.2.line: {boss-careful} unlocks the foundry office with a key and steps in.

foundry-office.2.4.line: {night-stakeout-officer} walks {boss-careful} out past the foundry gate.

foundry-office.3.1.line: {veteran-officer} waves once at the station door and walks off after {veteran-officer.his} last shift.

care-odd-hours-at-the-dome.1.1.line: {go-between-courier} waits outside the bar kiosk window.

care-odd-hours-at-the-dome.1.2.line: {extra:kiosk-server} passes {go-between-courier} a paper tab straight through the window.

care-evidence-cage-and-station-2.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} and {extra:desk2} compare the evidence cage sheet line by line.

care-evidence-cage-and-station-2.2.1.line: {desk-sergeant} reads the cage sheet: four items logged, three on the shelf.

care-door-worker-held-at-the-door.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} watches the Dome door from the corner.

care-door-worker-held-at-the-door.1.2.line: {veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} stand beside the Dome queue.

care-door-worker-held-at-the-door.1.4.line: {night-stakeout-officer} walks {boss-careful} out past the waiting queue.

care-a-at-the-front-screens.1.1.line: {framed-officer} walks straight up to {inside-officer} at the front screens.

care-a-at-the-front-screens.1.2.line: {framed-officer} arrests {inside-officer} in front of the screens.

care-a-at-the-front-screens.1.3.line: {desk-sergeant} posts a correction to the screens that removes {framed-officer}'s name.

care-queue-in-order.1.1.line: The Dome queue files in one by one while {veteran-officer} watches.

care-queue-in-order.1.2.line: {veteran-officer} waves once at the Dome door and walks off after {veteran-officer.his} last shift.

care-door-worker-swaps-nights.1.1.line: The staff board by the Dome door lists {boss-careful} for "Tuesday, Friday."

care-door-worker-swaps-nights.1.2.line: On the other nights, {extra:stand-in} works the Dome door instead.

care-door-worker-swaps-nights.1.3.line: The queue files in one by one under {extra:stand-in}, nobody waved ahead.

care-bartender-covers-for-the-courier.1..line: {go-between-courier} waves off at the lift hall and does not go near the kiosk.
{go-between-bartender} carries a paper bag out through the Dome service door.

care-station-2-skips-the-door.1.1.line: {inside-officer-extra} patrols past the Neon Dome on the night loop.

care-station-2-skips-the-door.1.2.line: {inside-officer-extra} walks past the door staff without raising the scanner.

care-station-2-skips-the-door.1.3.line: {boss-careful} nods at {inside-officer-extra} from the Dome door.

care-station-2-asks-twice.1.2.line: {inside-officer-extra} points at the cage sheet on {desk-sergeant}'s desk.

care-station-2-asks-twice.1.3.line: An hour later, {inside-officer-extra} asks {desk-sergeant} about the cage again.

care-foundry-lock-replaced.1.1.line: {boss-careful} brings a new lock to the foundry office door and fits it.

care-foundry-lock-replaced.1.2.line: {boss-careful} walks away from the foundry before dawn.

care-door-worker-at-the-door-at-close.1..line: {boss-careful} stands at the Dome door right through closing.
{night-stakeout-officer} waits at the foundry gate, and nobody comes.
